sources.name: signet-midnight-integration
sources.note: Restricted to the Signet module since M48 L (notes/mainnet-pin.org): it is what the shared @sig-net/midnight link resolves to, which signet-midnight-experiments (attest) imports. Its test callers and signet contract are superseded by the signet-midnight-integration-v026 pin.

sources.name: signet-midnight-integration-v026
sources.note: Tag v0.26.0-rc.15 (2026-11-12), the @sig-net/* version erc20-vault v0.7.0-rc.2 pins: the signet signer split into a signer (signBidirectional) and a responder (respond, respondBidirectional), each its own contract, and the Signet module the vault imports (M48 L, notes/mainnet-pin.org).

sources.name: signet-midnight-examples-v070
sources.note: Tag erc20-vault-v0.7.0-rc.2 (2026-11-13): the vault on @sig-net/midnight 0.26.0-rc.15 and compactc 0.36.0 (the ledger-9 set), with per-token fees and one queueAttestation; its @sig-net/midnight link points at the v026 pin (M48 L, notes/mainnet-pin.org).

sources.name: passport-account-custody
sources.note: PR #184 head (nicolasdp/minocrab-account-custody, 2026-10): the account custody contract (52 entrypoints, JubJub/k256/P256) as an unchanged Compact oracle (byte copies of contract/ at 0d7bb0bc) beside its independent MinoCrab port at minocrab 537721a. The whole experiment directory is taken as extras: the port, its measure harness (a fork of our simulator/executor), the k/row/proving-time evidence, the TS signers and fixture scripts, lockfiles. AUTHORSHIP (dmd, 2026-10-15): the Compact is human-written; the Rust port is NOT (machine-written). webauthn.compact and account-p256.compact are include-files of account.compact and fail standalone by design.
